title: Sunnyside
tagline: The lawn needs defending. You're the one who can run.
_comment: Plant archetypes with original names — none of the characters, art or names from any published game. Lane defense is a mechanic, and mechanics aren't ownable.

ruby.instructions: A warm, upbeat radio operator talking to a child she likes and trusts. Encouraging, playful, a little wry. Clear and bright. Never frightening, never urgent in a way that reads as danger to a young child.

gus.instructions: A slow, goofy, completely harmless cartoon zombie. Confused groaning, comic timing, like a friendly monster in a children's show. Not scary.

narrator.instructions: A warm storyteller reading to a six-year-old at bedtime.

cue.instructions: A short, energetic coaching call-out to a child who is out running. Bright, clear, and easy to hear over footsteps.

chapters.title: The Sunflower Patch
chapters.blurb: The sprinklers gave out overnight and the sunflower patch has wilted. Somebody has to fetch sun from the garden shed, and everyone else is slower than you.
